map.周转率 = 营业成本 / 平均存货。: Compute inventory turnover and turnover days from cost of goods sold and average inventory balance.
map.存货周转率 = 销售成本/平均存货: Inventory Turnover = Cost of Sales / Average Inventory
map.周转率越高变现越快。: The higher the turnover, the faster inventory is converted to cash.
map.衡量一年内存货被卖出并补充的次数，反映运营效率。: Measures how many times inventory is sold and replenished in a year, reflecting operating efficiency.
map.零售、制造等行业用周转率评估采购与销售节奏是否匹配。: Retail, manufacturing and other industries use turnover to assess whether purchasing and sales are in step.
map.对比行业，发现滞销品或备货过量问题。: Compare with the industry to spot slow-moving goods or overstocking.
map.某公司年度销售成本 3600 万元，期初存货 250 万元、期末 350 万元，: A company has annual cost of sales of 3600 (10k CNY), beginning inventory of 250 (10k CNY) and ending inventory of 350 (10k CNY), so average inventory = 300 (10k CNY) and inventory turnover = 3600/300 = 12 times per year, turning over about every 30 days.
map.存货周转率和存货天数有什么关系？: How does inventory turnover relate to inventory days?
map.两者互为倒数（天数=365÷周转率）；高周转率对应短天数，都衡量存货运营效率，只: The two are reciprocals (days = 365 ÷ turnover); a high turnover corresponds to few days, and both measure inventory operating efficiency from different angles.
map.高周转率一定好吗？: Is a high turnover always good?
map.高周转通常意味着畅销、资金高效，但也可能备货不足错失销售；生鲜等行业天然高周转，: High turnover usually means strong sales and efficient use of capital, but it may also mean understocking and missed sales; fresh-goods industries turn over naturally fast while durable goods are slower, so compare within the same industry.
